name: Hedge Mod Manager
note: HedgeModManager, the mod manager for Sonic games. Version 7 says "Hedge Mod Manager" (its AssemblyInfo.cs); version 8 is a single-file .NET program whose exe carries its main assembly's name, "HedgeModManager.UI", checked on 8.0.0 beta 7 in Magic Kettle. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.
